analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. proposes sending 24-year-old TE Tyler Warren (97.3 C-AVI) and starting QB Tyler Shough (54.8 C-AVI) to Big Balder Brand in exchange for TE Trey McBride (99.5 C-AVI). While McBride is consensus TE1 in fantasy football, Tyler Warren is already an S-tier TE scoring 97.3 C-AVI and is two years younger. Surrendering a starting NFL QB in Tyler Shough in a 16-team league to achieve a marginal +2.2 C-AVI upgrade at TE represents a clear overpay and strips Corgi Loaf of crucial QB depth behind Patrick Mahomes. Big Balder Brand wins this trade comfortably by acquiring a starting QB asset while taking a negligible 2.2-point production drop at TE.

verdict.rationale: Do not send this trade as constructed. Including Tyler Shough to upgrade from 24-year-old Tyler Warren (97.3 C-AVI) to Trey McBride (99.5 C-AVI) is an unnecessary overpay that strips your roster of QB depth in a 16-team league for a minor +2.2 C-AVI boost. Revise the offer by removing Tyler Shough and offering Tyler Warren plus a minor draft pick if you wish to target McBride.
